items.title: Auto-refresh the finding-signals cache in applyDoneMergeEffects after the DONE merge
items.context: In handlers/done-effects.ts applyDoneMergeEffects (~after the bumpVersionOnDoneMerge / runDoneMainPackageBuildAfterMerge calls at ~890-896, post-merge, inside the main write-lock), re-derive + persist the finding-signals cache by calling deriveFindingSignalsFromStore(store, { projectRoot: <root> }) (core/finding-signals.ts) — which writes via learning-store writeFindingSignals → resolveLearningRoot (canonical MAIN cache, post-B-37b3). Run it on EVERY DONE merge (do NOT gate on shouldBuildDoneMainPackageForChangedPaths). Wrap in try/catch: NEVER throw or block the merge; append an advisory mergeLines status line (e.g. "experience cache refreshed (N signals)" or "experience cache refresh skipped: <reason>"). Use the correct root so the cache lands in the main checkout. Do NOT change learning-store.ts (B-37b3 resolver) or version-bump.ts. Keep the effect advisory-only (no gate reads it).
items.userSees: After any `story_advance --phase=DONE` that merges to main, the merge report shows an "experience cache refreshed (N signals)" line, and .lattice/learning/finding-signals.json updatedAt advances to include the just-completed story's findings — no manual `learning_scan` needed.

items.title: Smoke: DONE merge auto-refreshes the cache and never breaks the merge
items.context: Add a smoke (packages/main/src/tasks/*-smoke.ts, auto-discovered + npm wiring) that drives a DONE merge for a story carrying a resolved finding and asserts the finding-signals cache is (re)written/updated as part of applyDoneMergeEffects (updatedAt advances and/or the new story's signal appears), without a separate learning_scan. Include a control proving a derive failure is swallowed (advisory line, merge still succeeds). Prefer driving the real applyDoneMergeEffects / the real derive+write path. Bump the printed check count.
items.userSees: node packages/main/dist/tasks/<smoke>.js prints its checks and exits 0; full npm test exits 0 with the new smoke in the chain.
